summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing for LATO SEGRETO Italian platform. Verified language compliance (Italian-only, no German/English), media grid layout (3 photos + 1-2 videos visible together), video autoplay attributes, signature transformation (same-URL swap with theme-secret class), sound toggle, conversion CTAs, and admin ModelEditor with transform preview. All core requirements verified on mobile (390x844) and desktop (1920x1080).
